start: Phone's Help and feedback open, watch connected, the watch app used during a workout today

steps.action: Tick "Add my watch's screen log" on the phone
user_sees: The phone asks the watch for its screen log
The watch answers within a second or two (urgent send)
must_not: The phone waits for the watch's next routine sync
The log is taken without the member ticking the box

user_sees: The message goes with the watch's screen log attached
must_not: The log holds heart rate, weights or exercise names
The message is lost because the watch did not answer

start: Phone's Help and feedback open; the watch is out of Bluetooth range, or the watch app was never opened

steps.action: Tick "Add my watch's screen log" and tap Send
user_sees: unknown: the phone's words when the watch does not answer are outside this area's code
The watch side sends an empty log when it has none
must_not: An old log from another watch is attached
The message cannot be sent because the watch did not answer

start: The member used the watch over three workouts

steps.action: Open and leave the watch app many times (about 75 times over three workouts)
user_sees: The watch keeps only its newest 150 log lines
must_not: The log grows without end and slows the watch
A line is cut in the middle

steps.action: Add the watch's screen log to a feedback message and send it
user_sees: The newest lines (about the last two workouts), oldest first
must_not: Lines from the first workout reported as today's
The lines out of time order

start: The member ticks "Add my watch's screen log"

steps.action: Read the caption, then send the log
user_sees: Caption: "It holds only the times your watch screen turned on, off or dim, and your watch's Battery Saver and screen settings."
The log's lines: screen on/off/dim times, Battery Saver, always-on and theatre settings, idle state, and whether a workout was open
must_not: Heart rate, set numbers, exercise names or the gym's name in the log
The log reaching anyone without the member's Send

start: HQ app open on the feedback list; a member sent a message with the watch's screen log

user_sees: The message, and the watch log lines such as "11-12 18:04:10.120 stop ambient=0 workout=1 ..."
must_not: The log cut so the last lines are missing

start: HQ app open on a feedback message sent without the watch log

user_sees: The message with no watch log part
must_not: An empty log block that looks like a watch with no screen events
An error in place of the message

start: The same member sent two feedback messages with the watch log a week apart

steps.action: Open the older message, then the newer one
user_sees: Each message shows the log as it was when that message was sent
must_not: The newer log written over the older message's log

start: HQ admin reads a watch log

steps.action: Look at who else can read the same message
user_sees: Only HQ reads the watch log
must_not: The gym's owner or staff see the member's watch log
The log shows anything beyond screen and power states and times
